Newyorské dopoledne. V Tape trvá od 7:00: The New York morning. In Tape it runs from 7:00 to 12:00 New York time. The most active part of the day for indices, mainly after the market open at 9:30.
Postup od vyššího timeframu k nižšímu: n: Working from the higher timeframe to the lower: first the direction and target on the daily chart, then the structure on the hourly and finally the entry on the minutes.
Rozpětí asijské seance, v Tape od 18:00: The range of the Asian session, in Tape from 18:00 to 2:30 New York time. Its high and low serve as liquidity in London and New York.
Verifying rules on historical data. Without it you don't know whether a model makes anything.
Klesající, medvědí. Bearish svíčka zavře: Falling. A bearish candle closed below its open, a bearish market is falling.
Jiný název pro bullish FVG: mezera vznik: Another name for a bullish FVG: a gap formed during a strong rally.
Jednotka ceny futures. Jeden bod jsou čt: The price unit of futures. One point is four ticks.
Svíčka zavře za posledním vrcholem nebo: A candle closes beyond the last high or low in the trend's direction. It confirms that the trend continues.
Pásmo, kde se překrývá bullish a bearish: The band where a bullish and a bearish FVG overlap. Price passed through it quickly in both directions and ICT treats it as a strong zone.
Posun stop-lossu na vstupní cenu. Obchod: Moving the stop-loss to the entry price. The trade can then no longer end in a loss.
Order block, který cena po výběru likvid: An order block that price broke through after a liquidity grab. On the return it works from the other side.
Likvidita nad vrcholy. Leží tam stop-los: Liquidity above highs. Sellers' stop-losses and breakout buy orders sit there.
Rostoucí, býčí. Bullish svíčka zavřela n: Rising. A bullish candle closed above its open, a bullish market is rising.
Čekající příkazy na nákup nad cenou a na: Pending buy orders above price and sell orders below price. Mostly they are stop-losses; together they make up liquidity.
Otevření americké akciové burzy v 9:30 n: The opening of the US stock market at 9:30 New York time. From that moment NQ and ES tend to have the most movement and volume.
Rozpětí mezi 14:00 a 20:00 newyorského č: The range between 14:00 and 20:00 New York time. ICT uses it in forex to estimate the daily high and low.
Střed mezery, tedy 50 % FVG. Častá úrove: The middle of the gap, that is 50 % of the FVG. A common entry level. When a candle closes beyond it, the gap weakens.
První průraz swingu proti dosavadnímu tr: The first break of a swing against the existing trend. A term from the related SMC school; in ICT the same thing is called MSS.
Svíčka zavře za otevírací cenou poslední: A candle closes beyond the opening price of the last candle (or run of candles) that went in the old direction. It is an earlier reversal signal than the MSS, because it doesn't break a swing, only a candle's open. A wick is not enough, the body has to close.
Úsek mezi výrazným swing high a swing lo: The stretch between a significant swing high and swing low in which price is currently trading. Premium, discount and equilibrium are measured within it.
Obchodování s cvičnými penězi. Slouží k: Trading with practice money. It serves to verify a plan without risk.
Pracovní předpoklad, kterým směrem dnes: A working assumption about which way price is more likely to go today. Trades are taken in one direction only according to it.
Nejvyšší ztráta, po které ten den končíš: The largest loss after which you stop for the day. At prop firms it is a fixed rule.
Typický průběh dne: kdy vznikne high a l: The typical course of a day: when the high and low form and when the main move comes.
Dolní polovina dealing range. Cena je ta: The lower half of the dealing range. Price is cheap there, you look for buys.
Rychlý, silný pohyb jedním směrem s velk: A fast, strong move in one direction with large candle bodies.
Likvidita nebo mezera, ke které cena nej: The liquidity or gap that price is most likely heading for. It serves as both the direction and the trade target.
Pokles účtu od posledního maxima. Ukazuj: The drop in the account from its last peak. It shows how deep a losing streak a model or trader went through.
Dva nebo víc vrcholů skoro ve stejné cen: Two or more highs at almost the same price. Stops build up above them, so price often takes them.
Dvě nebo víc den skoro ve stejné ceně. P: Two or more lows at almost the same price. Stops build up below them.
Přesná polovina dealing range, hranice m: The exact middle of the dealing range, the border between premium and discount.
Likvidita na okrajích dealing range, ted: Liquidity at the edges of the dealing range, that is above its high and below its low.
Futures na index S&P 500. Bod má hodnotu: Futures on the S&P 500 index. A point is worth 50 USD. The smaller version is MES with a point worth 5 USD.
Elektronické obchodování futures skoro p: Electronic futures trading almost all day, including the night.
Zkouška u prop firmy: dosáhnout cílového: The test at a prop firm: reach the profit target without exceeding the allowed daily and total loss.
Rychlý pohyb ven z konsolidace. Spolu s: A fast move out of consolidation. Together with consolidation, retracement and reversal it makes up the four phases price goes through according to ICT.
Trh se pokusí o nový vrchol nebo dno, al: The market tries for a new high or low but doesn't reach it and turns. It differs from a sweep in that it doesn't exceed the old extreme.
Nástroj, který rozdělí pohyb na procenta: A tool that divides a move into percentages. In ICT the main levels watched are 50 %, 62 %, 70.5 % and 79 %.
Rozpětí od 15:00 do půlnoci newyorského: The range from 15:00 to midnight New York time, that is the CBDR joined with the Asian session. It is used similarly to the CBDR.
Strach, že ti pohyb uteče. Vede ke vstup: Fear of missing the move. It leads to entries without a setup.
Zkouška modelu na nových datech v reálné: A trial of the model on new data in real time, typically on a demo account. It follows the backtest.
Smlouva, jejíž cena kopíruje nějaký trh,: A contract whose price tracks some market, for example a stock index. It trades on an exchange almost all day.
Mezera mezi knotem první a třetí svíčky: The gap between the wicks of the first and third candles in a three-candle move. ICT treats it as a zone price may return to.
Cenová mezera mezi zavřením jedné svíčky: A price gap between the close of one candle and the open of the next. It forms mainly over a break or the weekend.
Vyšší vrchol a vyšší dno. Jejich řada zn: Higher high and higher low. A series of them means an uptrend.
Cesta k likviditě s velkým odporem: v ce: A path to liquidity with high resistance: there are zones and swings in the way where price gets stuck, the move is slow and choppy.
Vyšší timeframe, například denní, čtyřho: Higher timeframe, for example the daily, four-hour or hourly chart. It sets the direction and targets.
Místo, kde se obchodovalo skoro jen jedn: A place where price traded almost only in one direction. ICT also calls it an inefficiency and expects price to return to it.
Po velké svíčce se hned další svíčka kno: After a large candle the very next candle touches the level of the candle before it with its wick, so no FVG remains. The imbalance was evened out immediately. ICT reads it as strength and doesn't expect price to return below that spot.
Skrytá mezera u velké svíčky, kde se kno: A hidden gap at a large candle where the wicks of the neighbouring candles overlap, so a classic FVG is not visible. It is counted between the midpoints of those two wicks.
Impuls je silný pohyb po směru trendu, k: An impulse is a strong move with the trend, a correction (retracement) a slower return against it. Entries are looked for in the correction.
Menší vrchol nebo dno, které láká obchod: A smaller high or low that lures traders into entering. Price then takes their stops before setting off in the real direction. A term mainly from SMC.
An FVG that price broke through with a body close. From that moment it works from the other side.
Představa ICT, že cenu doručuje algoritm: ICT's idea that price is delivered by an algorithm that alternately seeks liquidity and rebalances gaps. It is an interpretive framework, not a verified fact.
Posledních 20, 40 a 60 obchodních dní. V: The last 20, 40 and 60 trading days. ICT looks in them for the highest and lowest prices and unfilled gaps as targets.
Zóny uvnitř dealing range, hlavně FVG a: Zones inside the dealing range, mainly FVGs and order blocks. According to ICT price alternates between moving from internal liquidity to external and back.
Střednědobý vrchol nebo dno: krátkodobý: Intermediate-term high or low: a short-term swing that has less prominent short-term swings on both sides.
Falešný pohyb na začátku seance proti sk: A false move at the start of a session against the real direction of the day. It takes liquidity on one side and the market then turns.
Časové okno s největší aktivitou. Zhruba: A time window with the most activity. Roughly the Asian 20:00 to 0:00, the London 2:00 to 5:00 and the New York 7:00 to 10:00 New York time, for indices mainly 8:30 to 11:00.
Tenká čárka nad nebo pod tělem svíčky. U: The thin line above or below a candle's body. It shows where price went and came back from.
Víc důvodů na jednom místě, třeba FVG uv: Several reasons in one place, for example an FVG inside the OTE in a killzone. The more of them meet, the more weight ICT gives the setup.
The market moves sideways in a narrow band. According to ICT orders build up in it before the next move.
Jedna obchodovaná jednotka futures. Kont: One traded unit of futures. Contracts have an expiry date, for indices once a quarter, and then you roll to the next one.
Nižší vrchol a nižší dno. Jejich řada zn: Lower high and lower low. A series of them means a downtrend.
Místa, kde čeká hodně příkazů, hlavně st: Places where many orders are waiting, mainly stop-losses. Typically above old highs and below old lows.
Příkaz, který se provede jen za určenou: An order that is executed only at the set price or better. It may not get filled.
Místo s velkým množstvím čekajících přík: A place with a large number of pending orders, typically beyond a significant high, low or equal highs and lows.
Delší jednosměrný úsek s velkými svíčkam: A longer one-directional stretch with large candles and almost no overlap. According to ICT price passes through it again later.
Zavírání londýnské seance, zhruba 10:00: The closing of the London session, roughly 10:00 to 12:00 New York time. A common time for a correction of the morning move.
A buy. You make money when price rises.
Cesta k likviditě s malým odporem: v ces: A path to liquidity with low resistance: a series of untaken highs or lows lies in the way and no strong zone, so price passes easily.
Nižší timeframe, například 15m, 5m nebo: Lower timeframe, for example the 15m, 5m or 1m. It serves to time the entry.
Dlouhodobý vrchol nebo dno: střednědobý: Long-term high or low: an intermediate-term swing that has less prominent intermediate-term swings on both sides. There tends to be a lot of liquidity at it.
Krátké, asi dvacetiminutové okno, ve kte: A short window of about twenty minutes in which, according to ICT, price seeks liquidity or fills a gap. For example 9:50 to 10:10 or 10:50 to 11:10 New York time.
Záloha, kterou broker drží za otevřený k: The deposit the broker holds for an open contract. Thanks to leverage you control a large position with a small amount, so profits and losses grow fast.
Střed těla order blocku. Když svíčka zav: The middle of an order block's body. When a candle closes beyond it, the order block weakens.
Cena o půlnoci newyorského času. Nad ní: The price at midnight New York time. Above it the market is expensive for the day, below it cheap.
Podobný breakeru, ale bez výběru likvidi: Similar to a breaker, but without a liquidity grab: the market did not make a new extreme, it broke structure and the zone before the break then works from the other side.
Model nákupu: konsolidace, pokles po eta: The buy model: consolidation, a drop in stages into a higher-timeframe zone, a reversal and a rally back through the same levels.
Zrcadlový model prodeje: konsolidace, rů: The mirrored sell model: consolidation, a rally in stages into a higher-timeframe zone, a reversal and a drop back.
Ten times smaller versions of the NQ and ES contracts. The price is the same, a point is worth 2 USD (MNQ) and 5 USD (MES).
Postup z veřejného mentorshipu ICT: výbě: The procedure from ICT's public mentorship: a liquidity grab, a structure shift with displacement and an entry on the return into the FVG.
Změna struktury trhu. Svíčka zavře za po: Market structure shift. A candle closes beyond the last swing against the existing direction.
Mezera mezi zavřením futures v 17:00 a o: The gap between the futures close at 17:00 and the open at 18:00 New York time.
V Tape od 12:00 do 13:00 newyorského čas: In Tape from 12:00 to 13:00 New York time. The market tends to be slow and ICT does not trade at that time.
Časové pásmo, ve kterém se uvádějí všech: The time zone in which all times in ICT are given. It is mostly six hours behind Central European time, five for a few weeks a year.
Futures na index Nasdaq 100. Bod má hodn: Futures on the Nasdaq 100 index. A point is worth 20 USD. The smaller version is MNQ with a point worth 2 USD.
Mezera mezi pátečním zavřením a nedělním: The gap between Friday's close and Sunday's open of futures. ICT watches it as a zone all week.
Záznam každého obchodu: důvod, vstup, st: A record of every trade: the reason, entry, stop, result and a chart screenshot. Without it you won't know what to do differently.
Sepsaná pravidla: co, kdy a jak obchoduj: Written rules: what, when and how you trade, how much you risk and when you stop.
Počet kontraktů zobchodovaných za dané o: The number of contracts traded in a given period. ICT works with it little; price and time decide.
Změna směru trhu. ICT ho čeká hlavně po: A change in the market's direction. ICT expects it mainly after a liquidity grab at a higher-timeframe level.
Čtyři ceny svíčky: otevírací, nejvyšší,: The four prices of a candle: open, high, low and close.
Starší vrchol nebo dno, za kterým ještě: An older high or low beyond which untaken stops still lie.
Rozpětí první půlhodiny po otevření v 9:: The range of the first half-hour after the 9:30 open. Its high and low are short-term liquidity.
Poslední svíčka proti směru těsně před s: The last candle against the direction right before a strong move. A bullish order block is the last down candle before a rally, a bearish one the last up candle before a drop.
In ICT the direction in which price respects zones. In bullish order flow buy zones hold and price breaks through sell zones. It is not the flow of orders from the order book.
Mezera mezi zavřením běžné seance předch: The gap between the close of the previous day's regular session and the open at 9:30 New York time.
Pásmo 62 až 79 % návratu podle Fibonacci: The 62 to 79 % retracement band by Fibonacci. The deepest part of the correction, where ICT looks for an entry.
Cena v 8:30 newyorského času, kdy vycház: The price at 8:30 New York time, when US economic data comes out. The second reference price of the day.
Noční obchodování futures od 18:00 do 9:: Overnight futures trading from 18:00 to 9:30 New York time. Its highest and lowest prices are called the overnight high and overnight low.
Průměrný výsledek jednoho obchodu v R. K: The average result of one trade in R. When it is positive, the model makes money in the long run.
Souhrnný název pro zóny, na které cena r: A collective name for the zones price reacts to: order block, FVG, breaker, mitigation block, rejection block, liquidity void and old highs and lows.
Nejvyšší a nejnižší cena předchozího dne: The highest and lowest price of the previous day. Among the most watched liquidity levels.
Newyorské odpoledne. V Tape trvá od 13:0: The New York afternoon. In Tape it runs from 13:00 to 16:00 New York time.
Zóna, kde čekáš reakci ceny a hledáš vst: A zone where you expect a price reaction and look for an entry. A term mainly from SMC; ICT speaks of PD arrays.
Střed dlouhého knotu. ICT ho používá jak: The middle of a long wick. ICT uses it as a level just like the middle of an FVG.
Cena za provedení obchodu. U scalpingu s: The price of executing a trade. In scalping with small targets they eat a large part of the result.
Tři fáze dne nebo svíčky: akumulace (kli: Three phases of a day or a candle: accumulation (calm), manipulation (a false push) and distribution (the real move).
Horní polovina dealing range. Cena je ta: The upper half of the dealing range. Price is expensive there, you look for sells.
Součet zisků dělený součtem ztrát. Nad 1: The sum of profits divided by the sum of losses. Above 1 the model makes money, below 1 it loses.
Firma, která po složení zkoušky svěří ob: A firm that, after you pass a test, entrusts a trader with its capital and shares the profit. It has strict rules for maximum loss.
Svíčka, která se vrátila do order blocku: A candle that returned into an order block and bounced off it. It becomes a new zone for the continuation of the move.
První FVG, který vznikne po otevření v 9: The first FVG that forms after the 9:30 open. ICT uses it as a reference zone for the rest of the morning.
Nejvyšší a nejnižší cena předchozího týd: The highest and lowest price of the previous week. Higher-timeframe targets.
Pravidla vyladěná tak, aby skvěle seděla: Rules tuned to fit past data perfectly. On new data they then usually fail.
Velikost rizika na jeden obchod. Zisk 2R: The size of the risk on one trade. A 2R profit means double what was at stake.
Rozpětí mezi nejvyšší a nejnižší cenou z: The spread between the highest and lowest price over a given period. Also a market moving sideways between two boundaries.
Návrat ceny do mezery, při kterém se dor: A return of price into a gap that evens out one-sided trading.
Starší order block, který cena znovu pou: An older order block that price uses again after a reversal, this time in the direction of the new move.
Zóna tvořená dlouhým knotem na výrazném: A zone formed by a long wick at a significant high or low, from the candle body to the end of the wick.
Snaha vyhrát ztrátu hned zpátky dalším,: Trying to win a loss back right away with another, usually bigger and worse trade.
Přechod z končícího kontraktu na následu: Moving from an expiring contract to the next one. On that day the chart may show a price jump that is not a real market move.
Poměr možného zisku k riziku. RR 2 zname: The ratio of possible profit to risk. RR 2 means the target is twice as far as the stop.
Běžná obchodní doba americké burzy, 9:30: Regular trading hours of the US stock market, 9:30 to 16:00 New York time.
Část dne, kdy obchoduje určitá část svět: The part of the day when a certain part of the world trades. Tape uses this division in New York time: Asia 18:00–2:30, London 2:30–7:00, NY AM 7:00–12:00, lunch 12:00–13:00, NY PM 13:00–16:00. The borders are not official, different traders draw them differently.
Den bez směru, kdy cena vybírá stopy nad: A day without direction, when price takes stops both above and below the market. It tends to come before big news and ICT recommends not trading it.
Situace na grafu, která splňuje všechna: A situation on the chart that meets all the rules of the model. If one is missing, it is not a setup.
Prodej nakrátko. Vyděláváš, když cena kl: Selling short. You make money when price falls.
Jiný název pro bearish FVG: mezera vznik: Another name for a bearish FVG: a gap formed during a strong drop.
Setup vázaný na tři hodinová okna newyor: A setup tied to three one-hour windows of New York time: 3:00 to 4:00, 10:00 to 11:00 and 14:00 to 15:00. You look for an FVG after a liquidity grab.
Rozdíl mezi cenou, kterou jsi chtěla, a: The difference between the price you wanted and the price the order was executed at. It shows most on stops and during news.
Velcí hráči, banky a fondy. ICT vychází: The big players, banks and funds. ICT starts from the idea that they are the ones moving price to the liquidity of small traders.
Bod obratu v market maker modelu: výběr: The turning point in the market maker model: a liquidity grab at a higher-timeframe zone followed by a structure shift.
Příbuzný směr, který vychází z ICT a pou: A related school that grew out of ICT and uses partly different names, for example CHoCH, inducement or POI.
Dva příbuzné trhy, třeba NQ a ES, se roz: Two related markets, such as NQ and ES, diverge: one makes a new high or low and the other doesn't. ICT reads it as weakness of the move and a possible reversal.
Likvidita pod dny. Leží tam stop-lossy k: Liquidity below lows. Buyers' stop-losses and breakout sell orders sit there.
Násobky velikosti výchozího rozsahu, nap: Multiples of the size of a starting range, for example a consolidation or a false push, projected further. ICT uses them to estimate the target of a move.
Krátkodobý vrchol nebo dno: svíčka, kter: Short-term high or low: a candle that has a lower high (or higher low) on both sides.
Pohyb, který záměrně dojde pro stop-loss: A move that deliberately goes for the stop-losses beyond a level. Liquidity raid, run on stops and sweep describe the same thing.
Příkaz, který obchod sám zavře při určen: An order that closes the trade by itself at a set loss. In the model it sits behind the sweep extreme.
Pořadí vrcholů a den na grafu. Podle něj: The sequence of highs and lows on the chart. It tells you whether the market is in an uptrend, a downtrend, or moving sideways.
Obrázek jednoho úseku času na grafu. Uka: The picture of one stretch of time on the chart. It shows the open, high, low and close.
Cena krátce prorazí vrchol nebo dno, vyb: Price briefly breaks a high or low, takes the orders beyond it and comes back.
Místní vrchol nebo dno na grafu. Svíčka,: A local high or low on the chart. A candle with a higher high (or lower low) than the neighbouring candles on both sides.
Příkaz, který obchod zavře se ziskem na: An order that closes the trade in profit at a set price.
Nejmenší krok, o který se cena může pohn: The smallest step price can move. On NQ and ES it is 0.25 of a point.
Zásada ICT, že setup platí jen tehdy, kd: ICT's principle that a setup is valid only when both price and time fit. The right zone at the wrong hour is not enough.
Délka času, kterou pokrývá jedna svíčka,: The length of time one candle covers, for example 1m, 5m or 15m.
Stop-loss, který se posouvá za cenou, ja: A stop-loss that moves behind price as the trade grows into profit.
Převládající směr trhu. Nahoru při vyšší: The prevailing direction of the market. Up with higher highs and lows, down with lower ones.
Příkaz, který se provede hned za aktuáln: An order that is executed right away at the current price.
Obchod proti falešnému průrazu: cena pře: A trade against a false breakout: price exceeds an old high or low, takes the stops and comes back. The name comes from the trader Linda Raschke.
Typický průběh týdne: který den vznikne: The typical course of a week: on which day the weekly high or low forms and when the market gets going.
Tlustá část svíčky mezi otevírací a zaví: The thick part of the candle between the opening and closing price. In ICT the body close counts for breaks, not the wick.
Breaker, který se překrývá s FVG. Dvě zó: A breaker that overlaps with an FVG. ICT treats two zones in one place as a stronger entry.
Mezera vzniklá skokem ceny, typicky po z: A gap formed by a price jump, typically after news or at the open. According to ICT price fills it later.
Kolik kontraktů do obchodu dát. Počítá s: How many contracts to put into a trade. It is calculated from the stop distance so that the loss doesn't exceed the pre-set risk.
Události, které trhem hýbou nejvíc: rozh: The events that move the market the most: the rate decision (FOMC), inflation (CPI) and employment (NFP). Movement around them tends to be sharp and unpredictable.
Jak moc se cena za určitou dobu hýbe. Ve: How much price moves over a certain time. In a volatile market candles are large and both stops and targets are further away.
Mezera mezi těly dvou sousedních svíček,: A gap between the bodies of two neighbouring candles while their wicks overlap. A smaller relative of the FVG.
Přesný postup, jak do obchodu vstoupit:: The exact procedure for entering a trade: where the order is, where the stop and where the target.
Podíl ziskových obchodů. Sám nic neříká,: The share of winning trades. It says nothing alone; it is always judged together with the RR.
Zavření části pozice dřív, než cena dojd: Closing part of the position before price reaches the main target.
